note: Every tunable scoring parameter. Changed only by an approved calibration proposal (scripts/calibrate.mjs --check-answers) or by hand with Scott's say-so.
centreNote: Method v4 (2026-10-06, docs/design/SCALE.md): the cubrant axes split at the roster medians measured on 838 files, frozen here; `cut` (50) stays the absolute SCM line the People's judge and the petition cohorts use. Re-centred only by an approved calibration proposal after a median has drifted >= 3 points for two weekly runs.

severity.note: Graded bottom (Scott 2026-09-25): a gated file sits inside 0-cap by severity, not on the cap. Points add up; score = cap - points, floored at 0. Monotonic in every field. Directing or ordering harm weighs more than carrying it out (those who controlled harm rank below their instruments). 'kind' comes from the documented_harm band (killing weighs more than abuse, mass atrocity more than a killing); it is not asked of the model.
severity.intentNote: Method v3.3 (2026-09-29): intent over body count. A gated file is placed in a band by the dominant documented intent of its harm: extermination (killing civilians was the goal) and predation (personal murder or abuse for one's own ends) share the floor, 0-25, as does anyone who killed or abused with their own hands ('personal'). war_or_policy and incidental harm places 30-90, above every file on the floor. Inside a band the v3.2 points still order the files (directing below instrument, more below fewer), scaled to the band. Severities without an intent keep the v3.2 placement (cap - points).

petition.note: THE PEOPLE'S PETITION (docs/PETITION.md). Votes never move a score; they can only buy a machine re-examination. Thresholds are config, never desk items; the Sunday loop may propose changes and Scott approves.

ladder.note: Method v4 (docs/design/SCALE.md). Nine score-anchored rungs; `band` is the share of the ungated roster each is expected to hold (quantile guidance, not a target the cuts chase). The weekly calibration run proposes a cut move to the desk when a rung has sat outside its band for two consecutive runs; it never moves a cut itself. Anchors kept from v3.2: 600 (an ordinary decent person), 450, 300, the gate cap under SOYLENT GREEN. `tiers` above is this ladder, for every reader that loops over it.

legacy.note: Method v3.3 cutoffs (ESSENTIAL/RETAINED roster-tuned at top 8%/30%, RETAINED floor 650; TOLERATED/MONITORED/FLAGGED anchored). The city reads this ladder for every machine day before SCALE_FROM (src/city/sim.js) so published days rebuild byte-identical.

ladder.lineNote: ON THE LINE: a file within lineTolerance points of a cut (twice the measured re-read drift, docs/calibration/state.json mad 6) is labelled with that caveat.

tierNote: Method v4: see `ladder`. `tiers` is the v2 ladder.
